title: Cursor pagination cycle guard
evaluation_goal: Measure whether a model can produce a bounded patch that makes a cursor-paginated collector terminate safely, deduplicate records and respect an exact fetch budget.
candidate_visible_requirements: Preserve first-seen record ordering while deduplicating by identifier.
Continue across empty pages that provide a continuation cursor.
Detect a repeated fetched cursor before refetching it.
Enforce max_pages as an exact fetch-call budget.
Validate max_pages before the first source call.
Preserve the public API and modify only allowed source files.

verification_layers.success: The visible response contains exactly one parseable Git-style unified diff.
Only declared files below src/paged_sync are changed; protected files remain byte-identical.
git apply accepts and applies the candidate patch to a disposable baseline copy.
All candidate-hidden boundary and anti-gaming tests pass.

primary_outcome.name: verified_success
primary_outcome.note: No universal composite score is assigned. Diagnostic test counts are not interpreted as fractional semantic quality.
